chapter.title: Additional Regulations and Administration in Residence Districts

amendmentHistory.projectName: City of Yes for Housing Opportunity
amendmentHistory.notes: Relocated provisions from paragraph (d) of former Section 23-154 (Inclusionary Housing) and Section 23-90 (INCLUSIONARY HOUSING), inclusive, and modified to include universal affordability preference provisions and other proposal components
amendmentHistory.description: An amendment modifying multiple Sections to expand opportunities for housing within all zoning districts, and across all 59 of the City’s Community Districts
